edited.description: Approvals with an item changed or removed before approving (the edit-before-approve count).

edited_share.description: The share of approvals that were edited before approving, from 0 to 1; 0 when nothing was approved.

invalid.description: Found invalid when they were made.

median_decision_seconds.description: The median time from a proposal to its decision, in seconds.

per_approver.description: What each person approved, the most first.

per_approver_task_type.description: What each person approved of each task type, the most first.

quick_share.description: The share of approvals made within ten seconds of the decider first opening the review with no item changed, or with no look recorded, from 0 to 1.

rejected_with_reason_share.description: The share of rejections that gave a reason, from 0 to 1.

reversed.description: Approved proposals a person undid afterwards (AI-91): reversals after approval.

reversed_share.description: The share of approvals that were undone, from 0 to 1; 0 when nothing was approved.

stale.description: Approved, then not run because a record had changed.

task_types.description: Each task type's share of the month's proposals, the most first.
